limits: Rough terrain foundation, not completed architecture, collision, navigation or mission unlock.
Original elevated/underground layers and transition reservations preserved; stairs/headroom/retaining/guard design still needs per-site engineering.
Opaque water previews are not the layered/translucent runtime water implementation.
Native floor/pile support does not certify full-width gameplay traversal, LAN, circuit lighting or performance.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.
